items.title: Understanding the Poem's Theme
items.explanation: The poem 'Paper Boats' by Rabindranath Tagore explores themes of childhood innocence, imagination, and dreams. The speaker launches paper boats down a stream to send messages to a stranger in another land, hoping that someone will find them and know who they are. The poet fills the boats with shiuli flowers from his garden, imagining fairies of sleep carrying these blooms safely to night-time lands.

items.title: Analyzing Imagery and Symbolism
items.explanation: Key imagery includes 'bulging sails' set by clouds, 'shiuli flowers blooming at dawn', and 'midnight stars'. The fairies of sleep are imagined as carriers of dreams in baskets. These elements combine imagination with reality to create a vivid picture where the child's personal details become part of a larger cosmic journey.
